description: This file implements the 'DrmSystem' class and related functions for handling DRM sessions, key statuses, and communication with Java via JNI in an Android environment, specifically for the Cobalt project.

classes.name: DrmSystem
classes.description: Handles DRM session management, key status updates, and communication with Java MediaDrmBridge in Android.

classes.name: DrmSystem::SessionUpdateRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to update a DRM session, including generating and managing JNI references.

methods.name: SbDrmSessionRequestTypeFromMediaDrmKeyRequestType
methods.description: Converts MediaDrm key request type to SbDrmSessionRequestType.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two SbDrmKeyId objects for equality based on their identifiers.

methods.name: Java_dev_cobalt_media_MediaDrmBridge_nativeOnSessionMessage
methods.description: JNI callback invoked when a session message is received from Java.

methods.name: Java_dev_cobalt_media_MediaDrmBridge_nativeOnKeyStatusChange
methods.description: JNI callback invoked when key status changes are received from Java.
